title: Model magic item passive modifiers: stats, movement, senses, environment (M2+M3)
description: Implement families M2 (23 rows) + M3 (38 rows) from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4 (exact membership = §2 rows tagged M2/M3). M2 shapes: ability score set-with-floor (19 / by giant type / belt table), score +2 with cap 20, permanent +2 score & cap (manuals/tomes), Str +4 cap 30 (hammer), PB +1 (ioun Mastery), AC formula replacement 15+Dex + spell DC/attack +2 (robe-of-the-archmagi), hp-max per level (berserker-axe), proficiency & language grants, death/rest rule hooks (periapt-of-wound-closure: F6 auto-stabilize, F7 double-HD healing), clock-driven regeneration (ring-of-regeneration, ioun Regeneration). M3 shapes: speed set/floor/increase/multiply, fly/swim/climb=walk grants, hover, water-walk, feather-fall, terrain exemptions, jump multipliers, breath/temperature adaptation, sustenance, darkvision/truesight/see-invisible/x-ray/detection senses with ranges. Hard rows: ioun-stone and ring-of-elemental-command need inline-variant structuring first (artifact §0 gap). Recommended agent: Codex GPT-5.5 (highest volume, most regular); Opus 4.8 one-time review of floor/cap semantics.
notes:
Implemented via packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemPassiveEffects.ts: projects the M2 (23 rows) + M3 (38 rows) passive-modifier clauses from the 2026-07-06 mechanics inventory for 56 of 58 unique tagged items, dispatched by item name with a per-item regex assertion (must()) against the real description text so future re-imports fail loudly on drift. Reused the existing shared mechanics.effects vocabulary (optMechanics/validateMechanicsEffect in kindSchemas.ts, already used by creature/spell/feature/condition kinds) rather than the PR #408 item_state/use_item architecture -- M2/M3 items are pure passive while-worn/attuned modifiers with no charge economy or live per-instance state, so none of that shared infra (item_state table, use_item tool, clause registry) was needed here. Added optMechanics(data,'mechanics',...) to validateDnd5eMagicItem (previously 'no mechanics field exists for this kind' per the inventory). New effect kinds: abilityScoreSet (floor semantics, value or tableRef), proficiencyBonusIncrease, healingMultiplier, hover, sustenance, swimWithoutExtraMovement, telepathicRelay, temperatureTolerance. Extended existing kinds: abilityScoreIncrease (+alsoIncreasesMaximum), hitPointMaximumIncrease (+perLevel, previously had no validator at all), regeneration (new validator: hitPoints|hitDice, +limb regrowth fields, previously unvalidated), sense (+durationMinutes, +bonusRangeFeetIfAlreadyHasSense), speedSet (+valueTableRef for table-driven speeds like Carpet of Flying, +floor, +hover), stabilize (+trigger). Deferred: Ioun Stone and Ring of Elemental Command (both M2+M3 tagged) need inline variant structuring first since each variant's benefits are mutually exclusive -- tracked as eshyra-xjp4 (child of this epic). Regenerated the canonical pack (56 magic-item records gained data.mechanics; verified via 'npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack' the committed pack matches importer output exactly, and 'npm run audit:dnd5e-srd-deep' reports 0 findings). Pinned the new partial field in srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (magic-item.mechanics missingCount 184/240). Added packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemPassiveEffects.test.ts and extended kindSchemasEffects.test.ts with payload-contract tests for every new/extended effect kind. Full suite: 3578 passed, typecheck clean, biome check clean.
PR #415 review (2026-07-07): reviewer found dropped source conditions/clauses in several extractors (Belt of Dwarvenkind darkvision+Dwarvish weren't conditioned on 'if you aren't a dwarf'; Cloak of the Manta Ray breathes lacked the hood-up condition present on its paired speed effect; Slippers of Spider Climbing's slippery-surface exclusion was asserted by must() but never emitted; Lantern of Revealing modeled only the sense clause though the whole item is M3-owned; Boots of Striding and Springing dropped the remaining-movement jump cap) plus flagged Crystal Ball as needing the same unstructured-variant deferral as Ioun Stone/Ring of Elemental Command, and asked for a stronger coverage gate than membership-count + golden examples. Fixed all in 6416495: full re-audit of all 56 extractors against source text found 5 more of the same class (Hammer of Thunderbolts holding-the-weapon condition, Horseshoes of a Zephyr no-tracks, Wand of Enemy Detection stop-holding condition, Rod of Lordly Might no-magnetic-north edge case, Necklace of Adaptation air/water-simplification flag); added optional condition field to breathes/jumpDistanceMultiplier/walkOnLiquids/abilityScoreIncrease; deferred Crystal Ball (55/58 modeled now, was 56/58; eshyra-xjp4 updated to cover all 3 deferred items); added magicItemPassiveEffectsCoverage.test.ts -- exhaustive it.each over all 58 tagged items (55 modeled + 3 deferred) asserting exact expected mechanics per item against real description text, plus a membership-count pin. Re-verified: 3638 tests pass, typecheck/check/verify:dnd5e-srd-pack/audit:dnd5e-srd-deep all clean; diff scoped to exactly the 11 fixed magic-item records.
PR #415 re-review (2026-07-07, round 2): found Necklace of Adaptation's breathes:['air','water'] couldn't represent 'any environment' faithfully (was disguising the lossiness as a condition string); Horseshoes of a Zephyr's 'leaves no tracks' nested inside walkOnLiquids' condition instead of being independent, plus the all-four-shoes prerequisite missing from all 5 effects across both Horseshoes items; Slippers of Spider Climbing's slippery-surface exclusion only on speedSet not climbAnywhere. Also asked for an independent (not self-referential) clause-level coverage gate since the prior coverage test's fixture was extracted from the module's own output. Fixed in c6b1de6: extended breathes with anyEnvironment:true; added new leavesNoTracks effect kind; added condition to climbAnywhere/hover via new markerWithOptionalCondition helper (fail-closed against other unexpected keys, unlike a bare optStr -- had to fix a pre-existing 18.7.9 negative test's expected error message, not weaken it); added magicItemPassiveEffectsMembership.test.ts, a baseline transcribed once mechanically from the inventory's master table (independent of the production module) asserting exact 58-key membership, exact 3-key deferred set, and a per-item minimum clause count. Re-verified: 3642 tests pass, typecheck/check/verify:dnd5e-srd-pack/audit:dnd5e-srd-deep all clean; diff scoped to exactly the 4 records touched. Updated the stale PR description (was still saying 56/58 modeled from round 1).
PR #415 re-review round 3 (2026-07-07): accepted the round-2 fixes and the scope argument against building the full #408 clause registry; remaining ask was narrower -- numeric alternatives/hard limits/effect scope still hidden in condition prose (Broom of Flying's alternate speed+capacity, Horseshoes of a Zephyr's hover height+surface scope). Fixed in 81b91e5: added speedSet.weightCapacity (maximumPounds/reducedValue/reducedAboveWeightPounds) for Broom; hover.heightInches + walkOnLiquids.surfaces (distinct from condition) for Horseshoes. Widened the search per reviewer's request and found 2 more of the same pattern: Carpet of Flying's capacity-doubling threshold (added speedMultiplier.thresholdTableRef+thresholdMultiplier -- first dedicated validator for that kind) and Cloak of Arachnida's web terrain scope on movementCostMultiplier (added terrain field mirroring ignoreDifficultTerrain). Re-verified: 3642 tests pass, typecheck/check/verify:dnd5e-srd-pack/audit:dnd5e-srd-deep all clean; diff scoped to exactly the 4 records touched.
PR #415 re-review round 4 (2026-07-07): reviewer approved round 3 overall but caught one real semantic bug -- Carpet of Flying's speedMultiplier.thresholdMultiplier:2 conflated the half-speed threshold (should be 1x table capacity, i.e. the table's own printed value) with the separate 2x hard carrying ceiling ('up to twice the table capacity'), wrongly pushing the half-speed reduction up to 2x instead of 1x. Fixed in c81d73f: replaced the flat thresholdTableRef/thresholdMultiplier fields with two independent nested objects, threshold:{tableRef,multiplier:1} and maximumCapacity:{tableRef,multiplier:2}. Re-verified: 3642 tests pass, typecheck/check/verify:dnd5e-srd-pack/audit:dnd5e-srd-deep all clean; diff scoped to exactly 1 record (Carpet of Flying). Reviewer said this looked like 'a very small final fix, not another broad audit pass' -- may be close to mergeable now.
PR #415 merged to main 2026-07-08 (merge commit 1817ce6). Branch eshyra-o9bd-18-7-7-5-passive-modifiers and its worktree deleted post-merge.
close_reason: Implemented M2/M3 passive-modifier projection for 56/58 tagged items; PR pending
